mapper.select: SELECT point_wallet_id AS pointWalletId, user_id AS userId, point_balance AS pointBalance, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM point_wallet_tbl WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT pt.point_transaction_id AS pointTransactionId, pt.point_wallet_id AS pointWalletId, pt.transaction_type AS transactionType, pt.point_amount AS pointAmount, pt.reason_type AS reasonType, DATE_FORMAT( pt.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS createdAt FROM point_transaction_tbl pt INNER JOIN point_wallet_tbl pw ON pw.point_wallet_id = pt.point_wallet_id WHERE pw.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY pt.created_at DESC, pt.point_transaction_id DESC
